long_biography.plain_text:
Panagopoulos studied foreign literature at Paul Valéry University in Montpellier before working in tourism and commerce. She later created Studio Alta Moda in Athens, giving her an entrepreneurial career independent of her subsequent public roles. Her interests increasingly turned toward sport, education and civic service.

As president of Kallipatira, Panagopoulos built programmes supporting women, Olympic and Paralympic athletes, sports facilities and medical equipment. Greece appointed her to represent the country on sport, tolerance and fair play at the Council of Europe, a voluntary role she used to promote the social values of athletics. She later served as an ambassador-at-large and as a special adviser on the Greek diaspora, with responsibilities covering cultural diplomacy and scholarships.
